description:
FILED s523a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-20) from #3282's measurement.  SILENT WRONG, pre-existing (base 8038fac6 identical).  PARKED-AREA: cl/pack-impl.pl is the pack oracle the USER parked (DECIDED: "pack/unpack PARKED (USER) until the XS decision"; the board review's "NOT IN THE PLAN" table lists "the pack park" as a USER decision) -- so s523a did NOT fix it; lifting it for this one rule is a Fable/USER call.

perl's rule (perlfunc pack, probed 5.40.3): a template that BEGINS with `U` is in U0 (character) mode.  pack's result is a CHARACTER string; unpack reads the string's characters.  A `U` later in the template (or after `C0`) packs / reads UTF-8 BYTES.  PCL applies the bytes rule always:
  pack('U', 0x83)          perl 1 char (131)        PCL 2 chars 194,131
  pack('U*', 0x1F600)      perl 1 char              PCL 4 chars 240,159,152,128
  unpack('U*', "\x01\x41\x83\xe9\xff")   perl 1,65,131,233,255   PCL 1,65,233,7
  unpack('U*', "\xc3\xa9") perl 195,169             PCL 233
  unpack('U*', chr(300))   perl 300                 PCL garbage (4)
  (`unpack('a U*', "x\xc3\xa9")` = x,233 and `unpack('U0U*', ...)` already agree with perl.)
Probes: scratch/s523a/pr/j2.pl, j3.pl, j5.pl in the s523a worktree.

THE SHAPE OF THE FIX (one rule, two copies -- p_pack and p_unpack in cl/pack-impl.pl, then tools/rebuild-pack): p_unpack's `my $utf8_mode = ($tmpl =~ s/^U0//)` should also be true for a template whose first item is `U` (not `U0` stripped -- the U stays as the first item and decodes the re-encoded bytes); p_pack should utf8::decode its byte result when the template begins with `U` (perl's "the resulting string is treated as UTF-8").  Probe pack.t's U rows before / after; the 47 parked pack.t keys may move.

COST OF NOT FIXING: JSON::PP's ascii / latin1 encoders (`unpack('U*', $_[0])`) and its \u decoder (`pack('U', hex)` + utf8::encode / utf8::decode) both go through it -- every JSON::PP ascii/latin1 encode of a non-ASCII char is wrong, and decoding any `\uXXXX` above 0x7F yields UTF-8 bytes.  That is the whole of JSON-PP t/099_binaryNN.t (16 files, 24,512 perl rows, #3282) and probably more of the JSON-PP board rows.  A one-iteration probe with JSON::PP::_encode_ascii replaced by a `map ord, split //` version (scratch/s523a/pr/c3patch.pl) stops the die; the decode half still fails the 4 ascii round trips.
subject: SILENT WRONG (pack park): pack/unpack ignore "a template beginning with U is U0 character mode" -- unpack("U*", "\x83") decodes bytes as UTF-8, pack("U", 0x83) gives 2 bytes; breaks JSON::PP ascii/latin1 encode + \u decode (#3282, 24,512 rows)
